scope: Read-only reconciliation of R360 furniture-use gap against current source and existing R340 native screen; no candidate code is justified by the evidence.

r360Correction.priorClaim: R360 classified companion use at the desk as not demonstrated.
r360Correction.correctedFinding: The narrow initial furniture-use slice is already implemented: placing the botanical desk in the home scene routes LUNA into a reading presentation, and the ordinary furniture screen shows LUNA reading at the placed desk with an explicit caption and remove control.
r360Correction.scopeLimit: This does not establish multiple furniture categories, user-commanded sit/use selection, final natural-motion quality, or Human art adoption. It does establish that the one existing desk-to-companion-use behavior is present, so it should not be tracked as unimplemented. If “利用動作” is intended to require a separately player-commanded interaction rather than furniture-triggered reading, that stricter interpretation is not established by the source of the acceptance text and should remain UNKNOWN; the currently documented one-table × companion-use example is visibly represented.

sourceEvidence.finding: The make-over sheet renders FurnitureRoomPreviewR275 and a persisted place/remove command for FURN_DESK_BOTANICAL.

In the home scene, placed botanical desk selects LUNA_READING__0, moves LUNA to the desk location, binds the reading body state and foreground hand overlay; update selects among reading frame IDs while the desk remains placed.

Uses a separate short-lived LivingScene configured with the current home cosmetics/furniture, labels the placed/stored state, and describes the desk-triggered reading presentation. Preview does not share the primary scene.

nativeEvidence.observed: Actual native screenshot says '机を置いた家', shows LUNA at the placed desk with an open book, includes the caption '机を置くと、ルナがこの場所で本を読みます。' and the '机をしまう' control.
nativeEvidence.runContext: The R340 ordinary navigation run had zero gameplay/save transactions; this frame proves the placed-state presentation, not that the tester changed placement in that run.

remainingStatus.furnitureUse: Implemented as one automatic desk→LUNA reading presentation and represented in a native screenshot. A separately player-commanded use action is not evidenced or required by the cited initial-slice wording; if that is intended, clarify before creating another interaction.
remainingStatus.appearanceAndMotionQuality: Still partial/unaccepted; this review did not judge animation continuity or art adoption.
remainingStatus.partyAndEnemyMotion: R313 says all four actors have source routes and walk routes, but no ordinary event-to-render sequence covering all four; R308/R340/R337 do not identify a new missing source pose. Treat as broad visual-acceptance gap, not a confirmed implementation bug.
remainingStatus.nextAction: Do not implement a duplicate furniture-use trigger. Continue the bounded ordinary event-to-render review for party/enemy motion; create a source correction only when a specific visible defect is reproduced.
